items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: I think KBCA has one of his records. I've asked and asked, and nobody's ever heard of Jimmy Scott out here, other than that one record.

ctx.x: Oh, baby. Nancy Wilson tries to sing like him sometime, and then other times she tries to sing like Dinah. But he was sort of an oddball looking character. He was lopsided. One shoulder was higher than the other. His feet were too long for his size, his height, and he looked like he was suffering from malnutrition. And his eyes weren't focused properly, you know? Like one was off to the side, somewhere. Nothing beautiful about him but his soul. And his phrasing was out of sight. And he sang so high, you'd think…

items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: I do recall recording with Little Crying Jimmy Scott on his label.

ctx.x: Bud was using Max Roach and Curley Russell.

And he had several other acts, you know. Music combos and things. On his label. And I do recall recording with Little Crying Jimmy Scott on his label. You know, Little Jimmy Scott? You've heard of him?
